---
title: '20260707'
version: 0.67.2
date: 2026-07-07
description: Added Claude Code fast mode, background and scheduled tasks, a GLM Claude Code provider preset, a settings cache reset, a new Codex/Claude binary management scheme, and a faster send/stop pipeline.
---
### New

- Claude Code now supports fast mode.
- Claude Code now supports background tasks and scheduled tasks.
- Added a GLM Claude Code provider preset.
- Added a Clear Cache option in Settings to reset local data anomalies that may occur during version migrations.

### Fixes and Improvements

- New binary management scheme for Codex and Claude, reducing usage issues caused by environment differences. Please refresh again under Settings → Agent.
- Optimized the send and stop message pipeline — it's faster now.
- Improved the data sync strategy.
- Fixed an issue where viewing a diff or file sometimes failed.
- Fixed the Add button being unclickable for overly long project paths.
- On Windows, the app title bar color now follows the theme.
- Fixed the keyboard not being dismissible in the mobile web version.
- Fixed images in conversations that sometimes could not be opened.
- Added a bug report entry to the mobile Settings page.
- Fixed a failed redirect when signing in on Linux.
- Opening an already-open project in Zed now focuses the existing window instead of opening a new one.
